title: Workload class identity + platform versions
description:
Schema for config/definitions/workload-classes.yaml — L1 platform definitions: the single source for Talos/Kubernetes/Flux versions and workload-class IDENTITY (name + intent + talos_type). Deliberately narrow: a class here carries NOTHING provider-shaped — no talos_patches (moved to providers/proxmox/classes.yaml talos_fragments), no node_labels/node_taints (labels derive from pool names, taints are declared by pools), no instance types. talos_type stays: it is role identity (which Talos machine type a class boots as), not tuning. Provider materializations live in providers/

/classes.yaml, which must cover every class named here.

classes.description:
Class identity: name (the key) + talos_type only. Anything else is provider-shaped and belongs in providers/

/classes.yaml.
